narration: Namespace is your single source of truth for what exists — an ISA-95 hierarchy of every site, area, line, and asset.
Enterprise rolls down into Celestial Park and the Home Garage, into the Conveyor Lab, the Stardust Racers, and your knowledge base — eighteen entities in all.
Create folders, upload documents, expand the whole tree in a click. Everything MIRA reasons about hangs off this structure.
One namespace. Your entire operation, organized.
